look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Look for low, fan-shaped, pleated leaves arising near the ground with smooth unarmed petioles, then check the branching flower or fruit stalks rising through and often above the crown.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Low fan palm with mostly subterranean trunk, commonly forming a short ground-level crown.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Costapalmate fan leaves with many deeply divided, narrow segments; petioles lack marginal spines.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Large branching panicles bearing numerous small pale flowers, sometimes extending beyond leaves.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Small round dark fruits on branching stalks; close-up needed for confident fruit-stage comparisons.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Usually lacks a tall exposed trunk; leaf bases clustered low.
